title: Giga Couch web-1 package
description: Minimal local package for the web-1 browser. This schema does not describe hashes, signatures, or a certified sandbox.

max.description: Optional. The most players this game allows. Players past it wait on their phones or pads until there is room.

players.description: How many people can play. Without max, everyone who joins gets to play; phones make dozens possible.

phone.description: How a phone controller looks while this game is open. Without it, phones show stick-2.

layout.description: stick-2: stick, A, B. dpad-2: d-pad, A, B, Start. stick-4: stick, A, B, X, Y, Start. twin-stick: move and aim sticks, A, Start. one-button: one large A. quiz-4: four large A, B, X, Y buttons.
